feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 September 2026 5:29am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 17 September 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure near Iceland, with associated frontal features affecting Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the east of the area.


##Weather##

Patchy rain in the east at first, otherwise isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing west or southwest 4 or 5 for a time early tomorrow morning, backing south or southwest 6 or 7 later in the morning. Veering west or southwest 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, soon becoming moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then rain spreading from the west on Friday morning, clearing to isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
